stages.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
stages.text: Pulled into Peter's world by the broken spell, this older Peter Parker finds him grieving May and shares the story of losing his Uncle Ben. He helps make the cures and blocks Peter from killing Norman Osborn, taking a stab from the Goblin for it.
stages.whoA: Another Peter Parker. He helps him grieve May and stops him killing Norman.
stages.whoB: Another Peter Parker, a younger one he helps through losing May.

stages.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
stages.text: This Peter Parker from another world finds Peter grieving May and tells him how he lost Gwen Stacy. He works with him on the cures, throws him the Goblin's cure, and saves MJ when she falls from the Statue of Liberty.
stages.whoA: Another Peter Parker. He shares the loss of Gwen and saves MJ.
stages.whoB: Another Peter Parker, younger, whom he helps through losing May.

stages.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
stages.text: Two Peter Parkers from different worlds meet when the broken spell pulls them both in. They swap stories of their losses and their webs, then fight side by side at the Statue of Liberty to cure the villains.
stages.whoA: Another Peter Parker. They compare losses and fight side by side.
stages.whoB: Another Peter Parker. They compare losses and fight side by side.

stages.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
stages.text: Peter takes Norman Osborn in and tries to cure him, until the Goblin takes over, turns the others against him and fatally wounds May. At the Statue of Liberty Peter nearly kills him in revenge, then helps inject the cure that gives Norman back his mind.
stages.whoA: The Goblin from another world, who kills May. Peter still cures him.
stages.whoB: A Spider-Man who takes him in, until the Goblin kills his aunt.

stages.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
stages.text: May finds Norman Osborn lost and frightened at F.E.A.S.T. and helps him, believing he can be cured. When the Goblin takes control again he beats her and fatally wounds her.
stages.whoA: A lost man she helps at F.E.A.S.T. His Goblin side kills her.
stages.whoB: The kind woman who helps him, until the Goblin kills her.

stages.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
stages.text: Strange locks Norman Osborn in a Sanctum cell and plans to send him home to die. At the Statue of Liberty the Goblin attacks him and breaks open the contained spell.
stages.whoA: One of the villains his broken spell pulls in. The Goblin attacks him.
stages.whoB: The sorcerer who jails him in the Sanctum and wants him sent home.

stages.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
stages.text: Otto Octavius attacks Peter on a bridge until Peter's nanotech takes over his arms. Peter builds him a new inhibitor chip that gives him back his mind, and Otto repays him by helping the Spider-Men cure Electro.
stages.whoA: Doctor Octopus from another world. Cured by Peter, he then helps him.
stages.whoB: A young Spider-Man who fights him, then cures him and earns his help.

stages.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
stages.text: When Doctor Octopus attacks Peter on a bridge, Strange pulls them back to the Sanctum and locks Otto in a cell. He means to send him home with the others.
stages.whoA: A villain his spell pulls in. He locks him in the Sanctum.
stages.whoB: The sorcerer who locks him in a Sanctum cell.

stages.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
stages.text: Flint Marko first shields Peter from Electro and lets himself be taken in, wanting only to get home to his daughter. He breaks away when the Goblin turns the villains, and fights the Spider-Men at the Statue of Liberty until they cure him.
stages.whoA: Sandman from another world. He helps, turns, and is finally cured.
stages.whoB: A young Spider-Man who promises to get him home, then cures him.

stages.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
stages.text: Curt Connors, still the Lizard, sits in a Sanctum cell when Peter first sees him. He flees when the Goblin attacks, and at the Statue of Liberty Peter tricks him into biting the cure.
stages.whoA: The Lizard from another world, whom he cures at the Statue of Liberty.
stages.whoB: A young Spider-Man who cures him at the Statue of Liberty.

stages.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
stages.text: With Sandman's help, Peter drains Max Dillon's power and brings him to the Sanctum to be cured. Max rips the cure off, steals an Arc Reactor and turns on him, until Otto helps the Spider-Men cure him.
stages.whoA: Electro from another world. He steals an Arc Reactor before he is cured.
stages.whoB: A young Spider-Man who tries to cure him and finally does.

stages.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
stages.text: Strange finds the Lizard in the sewers, catches him and locks him in the Sanctum. Peter first sees him in that cell as Strange explains what the broken spell has done.
stages.whoA: One of the visitors his spell pulls in. He catches him in the sewers.
stages.whoB: The sorcerer who catches him and locks him in the Sanctum.

stages.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
stages.text: At the Statue of Liberty the Lizard chases Ned and MJ through Ned's portals to get the box holding the spell. MJ throws Peter his cure while Ned keeps them a step ahead.
stages.whoA: The Lizard, who chases him and MJ through his portals.
stages.whoB: Peter's friend, whom he chases through portals for the spell box.

stages.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
stages.text: At the Statue of Liberty the Lizard chases MJ and Ned through portals to get the box holding the spell. MJ throws Peter the cure that turns him back into Curt Connors.
stages.whoA: The Lizard, who chases her through portals. She throws Peter his cure.
stages.whoB: Peter's friend, who throws Peter the cure that stops him.

stages.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
stages.text: Searching for Peter with Strange's sling ring, Ned opens a portal and this Peter Parker steps through into his home. While they work on the cures, he tells Ned how his own best friend, Harry, died in his arms.
stages.whoA: Another world's Peter Parker, who steps through his portal.
stages.whoB: Peter's best friend, who brings him through a portal.

stages.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
stages.text: Searching for Peter with Strange's sling ring, Ned finds this Peter Parker instead and brings him home. They work together on the cures and the fight at the Statue of Liberty.
stages.whoA: Another world's Peter Parker, whom he finds with the sling ring.
stages.whoB: Peter's best friend, who finds him and brings him in.

stages.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
stages.text: MJ and Ned find this Peter Parker while searching for their own Peter. She helps him and the other Peters prepare the cures and lure the villains to the Statue of Liberty.
stages.whoA: Another world's Peter Parker, who helps her Peter.
stages.whoB: Peter's girlfriend, who brings him to her Peter.

stages.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
stages.text: MJ and Ned find this Peter Parker while searching for their own Peter. When she falls from the Statue of Liberty he catches her, a rescue he could not make for Gwen.
stages.whoA: Another world's Peter Parker, who catches her when she falls.
stages.whoB: Peter's girlfriend, whom he saves from a fall as he could not save Gwen.

stages.title: Morbius
stages.text: Pulled into Michael's world by Strange's spell, Adrian Toomes builds a new winged suit and seeks Michael out. He suggests the two of them team up.
stages.whoA: Morbius, a living vampire in the world he lands in. He wants a team up.
stages.whoB: A stranger from another world who wants them to team up.

stages.title: Deadpool & Wolverine
stages.text: Wade brings this Logan from his own ruined world to replace his dead Logan, and the two fight each other at every turn. Trapped together in the Void, they slowly come to trust each other, destroy the Time Ripper side by side, and Logan stays on in Wade's world.
stages.whoA: Deadpool. They fight constantly, save his world together and become friends.
stages.whoB: The worst Wolverine, whom he recruits. They fight, then become friends.

stages.title: Deadpool & Wolverine
stages.text: Laura is the daughter of another world's Logan, cloned from his blood. In the Void she finds this Logan and convinces him to fight, and afterwards she chooses to stay with him.
stages.whoA: Another Logan's daughter. She talks him into fighting and stays with him.
stages.whoB: A Logan from another world, who becomes her friend.

stages.title: Deadpool & Wolverine
stages.text: A Sabretooth serving Cassandra Nova recognizes this Logan in the Void and challenges him to a fight. Logan cuts off his head.
stages.whoA: A Sabretooth in the Void who challenges him. Logan beheads him.
stages.whoB: A Logan from another world, who beheads him.

stages.title: Deadpool & Wolverine
stages.text: Pyro leads the hunting party that captures Logan and Wade in the Void. When he shoots Cassandra Nova and starts to gloat, Logan knocks him out with one punch.
stages.whoA: Cassandra Nova's man, who captures him. Logan knocks him out.
stages.whoB: A Logan from another world, who knocks him out cold.

stages.title: Deadpool & Wolverine
stages.text: Johnny breaks up Logan and Wade's fight in the Void and warns them that Cassandra Nova's crew is coming. Captured with them, he is killed by Cassandra, and Logan blames Wade for it.
stages.whoA: Johnny Storm, captured with him. Logan blames Wade for his death.
stages.whoB: A Logan he meets in the Void and is captured with.

stages.title: Deadpool & Wolverine
stages.text: Johnny finds Wade and Logan in the Void, warns them about Cassandra Nova, and is captured with them. Wade repeats Johnny's crude words about her to her face, and she kills him.
stages.whoA: Johnny Storm, captured with him. Wade's big mouth gets him killed.
stages.whoB: A mercenary captured with him, who gets him killed.

stages.title: Deadpool & Wolverine
stages.text: Blade is one of the resistance fighters who take Wade in, though he says plainly that he doesn't like him. Wade talks the group into raiding Cassandra Nova's lair, and Blade blows the gate open.
stages.whoA: Blade, a resistance fighter who dislikes him but joins his raid.
stages.whoB: A mercenary he doesn't like, who talks them into the raid.

stages.title: Deadpool & Wolverine
stages.text: When Wade swings at her in the resistance hideout, Elektra blocks his sword and throws him down. His plan to beat Cassandra Nova wins her over, and she pushes the others to join the raid.
stages.whoA: Elektra, who throws him down, then joins his raid.
stages.whoB: A mercenary who attacks her, then gives the resistance a plan.

stages.title: Deadpool & Wolverine
stages.text: Laura and Blade are part of the resistance, heroes stranded in the Void who hide from Cassandra Nova for years. They fight together in the raid on her lair.
stages.whoA: Blade, her fellow resistance fighter in the Void.
stages.whoB: Laura, his fellow resistance fighter in the Void.

stages.title: Deadpool & Wolverine
stages.text: Laura and Elektra are part of the resistance, heroes stranded in the Void who hide from Cassandra Nova for years. They fight together in the raid on her lair.
stages.whoA: Elektra, her fellow resistance fighter in the Void.
stages.whoB: Laura, her fellow resistance fighter in the Void.

stages.title: Deadpool & Wolverine
stages.text: Gambit and Blade are part of the resistance, heroes stranded in the Void who hide from Cassandra Nova for years. They fight together in the raid on her lair.
stages.whoA: Blade, his fellow resistance fighter in the Void.
stages.whoB: Gambit, his fellow resistance fighter in the Void.

stages.title: Deadpool & Wolverine
stages.text: Gambit and Elektra are part of the resistance, heroes stranded in the Void who hide from Cassandra Nova for years. Gambit doubts the raid on her lair, but they fight it together.
stages.whoA: Elektra, his fellow resistance fighter in the Void.
stages.whoB: Gambit, her fellow resistance fighter in the Void.

stages.title: Deadpool & Wolverine
stages.text: Paradox of the TVA offers Wade a place on the Sacred Timeline, then reveals he plans to speed up the death of Wade's world. Wade steals his TemPad, and Paradox banishes him to the Void when Wade sees he is acting alone.
stages.whoA: The TVA agent who plans to destroy his world.
stages.whoB: A mercenary he recruits, then banishes when Wade fights his plan.

stages.title: Deadpool & Wolverine
stages.text: Cassandra Nova rules the Void and leaves Wade and Logan to be eaten by Alioth. Wade and Logan trap her with Juggernaut's helmet, then fight her in their world until the Time Ripper's blast kills her.
stages.whoA: Charles Xavier's twin, ruler of the Void, who tries to destroy everything.
stages.whoB: A mercenary who traps her and finally destroys her.

stages.title: Deadpool & Wolverine
stages.text: Hunter B-15 arrives to arrest Paradox and congratulates Wade for saving his world. When he asks, she agrees to bring the resistance home from the Void and lets Logan stay in his world.
stages.whoA: The TVA leader who arrests Paradox and grants his requests.
stages.whoB: The mercenary who saved his world, and whose requests she grants.

stages.title: Deadpool & Wolverine
stages.text: Wade meets Dogpool, a Deadpool variant dog, in the Void, and she later turns up in his world. After the fight he adopts her as his pet.
stages.whoA: Dogpool, a dog version of himself, whom he adopts.
stages.whoB: The Deadpool who adopts her.

stages.title: Deadpool & Wolverine
stages.text: From inside the Void, Pyro secretly works for Paradox, who promises to free him if he kills Cassandra Nova. When Cassandra uncovers the deal, she sends him through a portal to Paradox and kills him there.
stages.whoA: The TVA agent who promises to free him if he kills Cassandra.
stages.whoB: His secret man in the Void, sent to kill Cassandra Nova.

stages.title: Deadpool & Wolverine
stages.text: Pyro serves Cassandra Nova in the Void and leads her hunting parties. He betrays her for Paradox and shoots her, and once she learns why, she snaps his neck.
stages.whoA: The Void's ruler he serves, betrays, and is killed by.
stages.whoB: One of her henchmen, who betrays her. She kills him.

stages.title: Deadpool & Wolverine
stages.text: When Pyro's hunting party surrounds him, Johnny flames on to fight. Pyro snuffs out his fire with ease and brings him to Cassandra Nova.
stages.whoA: The Human Torch, whose fire he snuffs out and captures.
stages.whoB: The fire mutant who puts out his flames and captures him.

stages.title: Deadpool & Wolverine
stages.text: Cassandra Nova has hunted Johnny for years. When he is brought before her and Wade repeats his insults, she skins him alive with her mind.
stages.whoA: The resistance fighter she has hunted for years, then kills.
stages.whoB: The Void's tyrant, who kills him.

stages.title: Deadpool & Wolverine
stages.text: Blade is one of the resistance who refuse to serve Cassandra Nova in the Void. He leads the raid on her lair, blowing open the gate.
stages.whoA: A resistance fighter who raids her lair.
stages.whoB: The Void's tyrant, whom the resistance fights.

stages.title: Deadpool & Wolverine
stages.text: Elektra is one of the resistance who refuse to serve Cassandra Nova in the Void. She pushes the group to raid her lair at last.
stages.whoA: A resistance fighter who raids her lair.
stages.whoB: The Void's tyrant, whom the resistance fights.

stages.title: Deadpool & Wolverine
stages.text: Laura is one of the resistance who refuse to serve Cassandra Nova in the Void. In the raid on her lair she kills Juggernaut and takes the helmet that blocks Cassandra's powers.
stages.whoA: A resistance fighter who takes the helmet used against her.
stages.whoB: The Void's tyrant, whom the resistance fights.

stages.title: Deadpool & Wolverine
stages.text: Gambit is one of the resistance who refuse to serve Cassandra Nova in the Void. He has watched friends die fighting her, and fights her henchmen in the raid on her lair.
stages.whoA: A resistance fighter who raids her lair.
stages.whoB: The Void's tyrant, whom the resistance fights.

stages.title: Deadpool & Wolverine
stages.text: This Sabretooth is one of Cassandra Nova's henchmen, hunting the Void's wastes for her.
stages.whoA: One of her henchmen in the Void.
stages.whoB: The ruler of the Void, whom he serves.

stages.title: Deadpool & Wolverine
stages.text: Toad is one of Cassandra Nova's henchmen and helps capture Wade and Logan for her. He dies fighting for her in the raid on her lair.
stages.whoA: One of her henchmen in the Void.
stages.whoB: The ruler of the Void, whom he serves.

stages.title: Deadpool & Wolverine
stages.text: Lady Deathstrike is one of Cassandra Nova's henchmen and fights for her when the resistance raids her lair.
stages.whoA: One of her henchmen in the Void.
stages.whoB: The ruler of the Void, whom she serves.

stages.title: Deadpool & Wolverine
stages.text: Juggernaut pledges himself to Cassandra Nova to survive the Void and guards her lair. His helmet, taken from his body, is what finally blocks her powers.
stages.whoA: Her henchman, whose helmet is used to block her powers.
stages.whoB: The ruler of the Void, whom he serves.

stages.title: Deadpool & Wolverine
stages.text: Azazel is one of Cassandra Nova's henchmen and dies fighting for her when the resistance raids her lair.
stages.whoA: One of her henchmen in the Void.
stages.whoB: The ruler of the Void, whom he serves.

stages.title: Deadpool & Wolverine
stages.text: Callisto is one of Cassandra Nova's henchmen and dies fighting for her when the resistance raids her lair.
stages.whoA: One of her henchmen in the Void.
stages.whoB: The ruler of the Void, whom she serves.

stages.title: Deadpool & Wolverine
stages.text: Blob is one of Cassandra Nova's henchmen, put in charge of the gate of her lair. He dies there when the resistance blows it open.
stages.whoA: Her henchman who keeps the gate of her lair.
stages.whoB: The ruler of the Void, whom he serves.

stages.title: Deadpool & Wolverine
stages.text: In the raid on Cassandra Nova's lair, Blade grabs Toad's tongue, chokes him with it and stabs him to death.
stages.whoA: One of Cassandra's henchmen, whom he kills in the raid.
stages.whoB: The vampire hunter who kills him in the raid.

stages.title: Deadpool & Wolverine
stages.text: In the raid on Cassandra Nova's lair, Azazel keeps teleporting out of Blade's reach until Blade cuts him down.
stages.whoA: One of Cassandra's henchmen, whom he kills in the raid.
stages.whoB: The vampire hunter who kills him in the raid.

stages.title: Deadpool & Wolverine
stages.text: Blade fires a rocket at the gate of Cassandra Nova's lair, killing Blob, who keeps it.
stages.whoA: The henchman at the gate, killed by his rocket.
stages.whoB: The vampire hunter whose rocket kills him.

stages.title: Deadpool 2
stages.text: Weapon XI is a younger Wade, turned into Stryker's weapon. With Cable's repaired time device, Wade travels back in time and shoots him dead.
stages.whoA: Weapon XI, his younger self as Stryker's weapon. Wade shoots him.
stages.whoB: His future self, who comes back in time and shoots him.

stages.title: X-Men: Days of Future Past
stages.text: Reaching back through Logan's mind, the older Charles speaks to his younger self in 1973. He tells the broken young man to hope again and to use his gift.
stages.whoA: His younger self, whom he urges to hope again.
stages.whoB: His older self, who tells him to hope again.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Wolverine blames Spider-Man when Beast goes missing and attacks him. Once Spider-Man saves his life, they team up to rescue Beast from Herbert Landon.
stages.whoA: Wolverine, who attacks him, then teams up to rescue Beast.
stages.whoB: Spider-Man, whom he blames for Beast, then teams up with.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: After Xavier turns Spider-Man away, Beast tells him about Herbert Landon's cure for mutation. Landon's men then capture Beast, and Spider-Man helps rescue him.
stages.whoA: Beast, who sends him to Landon, then needs rescuing.
stages.whoB: Spider-Man, whom he sends to Landon and who rescues him.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Fearing his mutation, Spider-Man comes to Xavier for a cure. Xavier tells him he cannot cure him, since his work is helping mutants accept themselves.
stages.whoA: Professor X, who tells him he cannot cure him.
stages.whoB: Spider-Man, who comes to him for a cure he cannot give.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Cyclops is among the X-Men who catch and question Spider-Man at the mansion. Later the team helps him stop the mutated Landon, and they part as friends.
stages.whoA: Cyclops, who questions him, then fights beside him.
stages.whoB: Spider-Man, who comes for help and fights beside them.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Jean shuts off the Danger Room when Spider-Man stumbles into it at the mansion. Later she joins the X-Men in helping him stop the mutated Landon.
stages.whoA: Jean Grey, who shuts off the Danger Room on him.
stages.whoB: Spider-Man, a visitor they help against Landon.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Storm questions Spider-Man when he comes to the mansion seeking a cure. Later he brings her to the Beyonder's world, where she fights on his team against the Red Skull and Doom.
stages.whoA: Storm, who later joins his team on the Beyonder's world.
stages.whoB: Spider-Man, who brings her to fight on the Beyonder's world.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Rogue flirts with Spider-Man when he comes to the X-Mansion looking for a cure.
stages.whoA: Rogue, who flirts with him at the mansion.
stages.whoB: Spider-Man, a visitor she flirts with.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Jubilee is with the X-Men when Spider-Man comes to Xavier for help. She joins them in helping him stop the mutated Landon.
stages.whoA: Jubilee, one of the X-Men who help him.
stages.whoB: Spider-Man, whom she helps against Landon.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Landon has Beast captured and reveals he has turned Hank's old research into a serum to destroy all mutants. He plans to test it on Beast before Spider-Man and Wolverine break in.
stages.whoA: Beast, whom he captures to test his anti-mutant serum.
stages.whoB: The scientist who captures him to test a serum that kills mutants.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Wolverine and Spider-Man fight through Landon's men to free Beast. When Landon mutates, Wolverine and the X-Men help bring him down.
stages.whoA: Wolverine, who storms his building to free Beast.
stages.whoB: The man who captures Beast and plans to wipe out mutants.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: After Landon falls into his own serum and mutates, Cyclops and the X-Men fly in to stop him draining the city's power.
stages.whoA: Cyclops, whose team stops him after he mutates.
stages.whoB: A mutant hater turned monster, whom his team stops.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: After Landon falls into his own serum and mutates, Jean and the X-Men fly in to stop him draining the city's power.
stages.whoA: Jean Grey, whose team stops him after he mutates.
stages.whoB: A mutant hater turned monster, whom her team stops.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: After Landon falls into his own serum and mutates, Jubilee and the X-Men fly in to stop him draining the city's power.
stages.whoA: Jubilee, whose team stops him after he mutates.
stages.whoB: A mutant hater turned monster, whom her team stops.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: As Wolverine fights Spider-Man over Beast, the Hobgoblin tries to kill them both with a pumpkin bomb.
stages.whoA: Wolverine, whom he tries to blow up with Spider-Man.
stages.whoB: The Hobgoblin, who tries to blow him up.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: On the Beyonder's world, Storm and the Invisible Woman combine their powers to recharge an abandoned lab for Spider-Man's team.
stages.whoA: The Invisible Woman, a teammate she recharges a lab with.
stages.whoB: Storm, a teammate she recharges a lab with.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Storm crosses the Beyonder's world with Spider-Man's team to bring down the Red Skull's empire.
stages.whoA: The Red Skull, whose empire her team topples.
stages.whoB: An X-Man on the team that topples his empire.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: On the Beyonder's world, Storm helps Spider-Man's team rescue the Thing from Doom and defeat him once he takes the Beyonder's power.
stages.whoA: Doctor Doom, whom her team defeats on Battleworld.
stages.whoB: An X-Man on the team that defeats him.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: In World War II, Captain America and a young Logan are sent behind enemy lines together to rescue a scientist from the Red Skull. They raid his base in France together.
stages.whoA: Wolverine, his partner on a wartime mission against the Red Skull.
stages.whoB: Captain America, his partner on a wartime mission.

stages.title: X-Men '97
stages.text: Years later, Captain America and Black Widow hand Wolverine a file on Weapon X.
stages.whoA: Wolverine, his old war partner, to whom he hands a Weapon X file.
stages.whoB: Captain America, his old war partner, who hands him a Weapon X file.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: In World War II, the Red Skull fights Captain America and Logan when they raid his base to rescue a scientist.
stages.whoA: Logan, who raids his base with Captain America.
stages.whoB: The Red Skull, whose base he raids in the war.

stages.title: X-Men '97
stages.text: While Rogue hunts Henry Gyrich, Captain America gives her a lead.
stages.whoA: Rogue, whom he gives a lead on Gyrich.
stages.whoB: Captain America, who gives her a lead on Gyrich.

stages.title: X-Men '97
stages.text: Captain America and Black Widow work together, and the two of them hand Wolverine a file on Weapon X.
stages.whoA: Black Widow, who works with him.
stages.whoB: Captain America, who works with her.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: This rich Spider-Man, whose identity is public, joins Peter's team of Spider-Men against Spider-Carnage. When he is left unable to move, Peter goes into his world in his place to stop Spider-Carnage there.
stages.whoA: A rich Spider-Man whose world he goes into to stop Spider-Carnage.
stages.whoB: The Spider-Man who leads them, and steps in for him in his world.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: A six-armed Spider-Man joins Peter's team against Spider-Carnage, but turns into the Man-Spider in the middle of the mission.
stages.whoA: A six-armed Spider-Man on his team, who turns into the Man-Spider.
stages.whoB: The Spider-Man who leads the team.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: A Spider-Man wearing Doctor Octopus's arms joins Peter's team against Spider-Carnage.
stages.whoA: A Spider-Man with Doctor Octopus's arms, on his team.
stages.whoB: The Spider-Man who leads the team.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: An actor who plays Spider-Man joins Peter's team against Spider-Carnage. Afterwards he explains that in his world Spider-Man is fiction, and Peter visits that world.
stages.whoA: An actor who plays him, on his team. Peter visits his world.
stages.whoB: The real Spider-Man, who leads the team and visits his world.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Ben Reilly, the Scarlet Spider, is a clone of the Peter Parker who became Spider-Carnage. He joins Peter's team of Spider-Men to stop his clone brother.
stages.whoA: The Scarlet Spider, Spider-Carnage's clone brother, on his team.
stages.whoB: The Spider-Man who leads the team against his clone brother.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Spider-Carnage is a Peter Parker from another world, bonded to Carnage, who means to destroy every reality. Peter leads a team of Spider-Men against him and chases him into another world.
stages.whoA: Another Peter Parker, bonded to Carnage, out to destroy every reality.
stages.whoB: Another Peter Parker, who leads the Spider-Men against him.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Chasing Spider-Carnage into another world, Peter finds that world's Uncle Ben still alive. Ben helps him by reaching the real Peter inside Spider-Carnage.
stages.whoA: Uncle Ben, alive in another world, who helps him stop Spider-Carnage.
stages.whoB: A Peter Parker from another world, who finds him alive.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: In another world, a living Uncle Ben speaks to Spider-Carnage and brings out the real Peter in him. The symbiote is too strong, and Spider-Carnage leaps through a portal to his death.
stages.whoA: Uncle Ben, alive in another world, who reaches the real Peter in him.
stages.whoB: A Peter Parker lost to Carnage, whom he reaches.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse
stages.text: Landing on Earth-42, Miles finds that world's Miles Morales is the Prowler. The other Miles captures him and holds him prisoner.
stages.whoA: Another Miles Morales, the Prowler of Earth-42, who captures him.
stages.whoB: The Miles from Earth-1610, whom he captures.

stages.title: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness
stages.text: Sinister Strange is a version of Stephen whose use of the Darkhold destroyed his own universe. When Stephen is stranded there, Sinister Strange attacks him over the Darkhold, and Stephen kills him in a duel fought with musical notes.
stages.whoA: Another Stephen Strange, corrupted by the Darkhold. Stephen kills him.
stages.whoB: Another Stephen Strange, who kills him in a duel.

stages.title: WandaVision
stages.text: S.W.O.R.D. sends the White Vision, built from Vision's old body, to destroy the Vision Wanda made. They fight until Vision gives him back his memories with a puzzle about which of them is real, and the White Vision flies away.
stages.whoA: The White Vision, his own old body, sent to destroy him.
stages.whoB: The Vision Wanda made, who gives him back his memories.

stages.title: The Marvels
stages.text: Stranded in another universe, Monica wakes to find that world's version of her late mother, Maria, alive as Binary. This Maria does not know her.
stages.whoA: Her mother's version in another world, who doesn't know her.
stages.whoB: A stranger who is her daughter in another world.

stages.title: Loki S1
stages.text: In the Void, Sylvie joins Loki and the band of variants led by Kid Loki, the young Loki who rules there. They stand together against President Loki's army and the storm Alioth.
stages.whoA: Kid Loki, a young variant who rules the Void.
stages.whoB: Sylvie, a variant who joins them in the Void.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.text: Kora is Daisy's half-sister, Jiaying's daughter, alive in the history the Chronicoms change. Siding with Nathaniel Malick, she fights Daisy at first, then turns on him, saves Daisy's life and heads into space at her side.
stages.whoA: Her half-sister. Enemies at first, then family who fight side by side.
stages.whoB: Her half-sister, an enemy at first, who saves her life.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.text: Jiaying is Kora's mother and raises her in Afterlife, trying to keep her unstable power in check. Kora breaks with her to follow Nathaniel Malick, who later kills Jiaying.
stages.whoA: Her mother, who raised her in Afterlife.
stages.whoB: Her daughter, who turns against her for Nathaniel Malick.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.text: As Nathaniel Malick's ally, Kora threatens to kill Daniel next. Once she joins S.H.I.E.L.D., she heads into deep space with him and Daisy.
stages.whoA: Daniel Sousa, Daisy's partner, who explores space with them.
stages.whoB: Daisy's half-sister, who explores space with them.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.text: Nathaniel becomes obsessed with Daisy after seeing her power. He kidnaps and tortures her to steal her powers for himself, and in the final battle Daisy kills him.
stages.whoA: The Inhuman whose power he steals, and who kills him.
stages.whoB: The HYDRA heir who tortures her to steal her powers.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.text: Nathaniel captures Daniel with Daisy and holds them both in a barn while he takes her powers. Daniel breaks them free.
stages.whoA: S.H.I.E.L.D.'s agent, whom he holds captive with Daisy.
stages.whoB: The HYDRA heir who holds him and Daisy captive.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.text: Nathaniel lures Jiaying's daughter Kora away from Afterlife and later kills Jiaying.
stages.whoA: Kora's mother, whom he kills.
stages.whoB: The man who turns her daughter against her and kills her.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.text: Nathaniel is Gideon's younger brother and Wilfred Malick's youngest son. While Gideon rises through HYDRA, Nathaniel stays shy and lost until he sees Daisy's power.
stages.whoA: His older brother, who rises through HYDRA.
stages.whoB: His younger brother.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.text: Searching the Time Stream for S.H.I.E.L.D.'s worst enemies, Nathaniel recruits a young John Garrett to his side.
stages.whoA: John Garrett, a future traitor he recruits.
stages.whoB: Nathaniel Malick, who recruits him.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.text: Freddy Malick, who grows up to be Wilfred Malick, is Gideon's father.
stages.whoA: His son.
stages.whoB: His father.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.text: By 1976, Freddy uses the Chronicoms' help to rush Project Insight for HYDRA. Deke kills him.
stages.whoA: Deke Shaw, who kills him.
stages.whoB: The HYDRA man he kills in 1976.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.text: In 1931, Coulson's team saves young Freddy from the Chronicoms, and he repays them by shooting Koenig for HYDRA. By 1976 he holds Coulson at gunpoint.
stages.whoA: Coulson, whose team saves him, then becomes his enemy.
stages.whoB: A HYDRA man his team saves, who betrays them.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.text: Sarge wears the face of Coulson, the man May loved. He takes her hostage and stabs her.
stages.whoA: An agent who loved the man whose face he wears. He stabs her.
stages.whoB: A man with Coulson's face, who stabs her.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.text: Sarge takes Mack hostage as he hunts the Shrikes on Earth. When Sarge embraces his true self, Pachakutiq, Mack kills him.
stages.whoA: S.H.I.E.L.D.'s director, whom he takes hostage and who kills him.
stages.whoB: A man with Coulson's face, whom he finally kills.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.text: Daisy fights Sarge, a man with Coulson's face hunting the Shrikes, and he tries to kill her.
stages.whoA: The Inhuman who fights him.
stages.whoB: A man with Coulson's face, whom she fights.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.text: Sarge comes for Deke to kill the Shrike he thinks is inside him. Deke greets him as Coulson, and Sarge plays along until he grabs him.
stages.whoA: The man he hunts, who mistakes him for Coulson.
stages.whoB: A Coulson lookalike who comes to kill him.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.text: Izel frees Fitz and Simmons in space and hires them to crew her search for the Monoliths. She turns on them and takes over Fitz's body.
stages.whoA: Fitz, her crew, then her host.
stages.whoB: Izel, who hires him, then possesses him.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.text: Izel frees Fitz and Simmons in space and hires them to crew her search for the Monoliths. She later turns on them.
stages.whoA: Simmons, her crew, then her enemy.
stages.whoB: Izel, who hires her, then turns on her.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.text: Izel jumps into May's body among others as she works to open a gateway for her kind. May kills her before her people can cross through.
stages.whoA: One of her hosts, who kills her.
stages.whoB: Izel, who possesses her. May kills her.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.text: Izel takes Mack hostage and jumps into his body as she works to open a gateway for her kind.
stages.whoA: S.H.I.E.L.D.'s director, her hostage and host.
stages.whoB: Izel, who takes him hostage and possesses him.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.text: Izel takes Elena hostage and jumps into her body as she works to open a gateway for her kind.
stages.whoA: One of her hostages and hosts.
stages.whoB: Izel, who takes her hostage and possesses her.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.text: Izel jumps into Deke's body as she works to open a gateway for her kind.
stages.whoA: One of her hosts.
stages.whoB: Izel, who possesses him.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.text: Izel tries to take over Daisy's body and kill her as she works to open a gateway for her kind.
stages.whoA: An agent she tries to possess.
stages.whoB: Izel, who tries to possess her.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.text: Keller and Elena grow close while serving together in S.H.I.E.L.D. When a Shrike takes him over, she has to kill him.
stages.whoA: Elena, the agent he grows close to.
stages.whoB: Keller, the agent she falls for, then must kill.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.text: Keller is one of Mack's agents while Mack is director of S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.whoA: His director.
stages.whoB: One of his agents.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.text: Mack brings Professor Benson into S.H.I.E.L.D. and shows him the Monoliths, and Benson helps study the alien threat.
stages.whoA: S.H.I.E.L.D.'s director, who brings him in.
stages.whoB: Professor Benson, whom he brings into S.H.I.E.L.D.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.text: Andrew was Benson's student at Culver University and later his friend and colleague.
stages.whoA: His former student, friend and colleague.
stages.whoB: His old professor, friend and colleague.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.text: Sibyl guides the Chronicom Hunters against S.H.I.E.L.D. through time. In the final battle Daisy destroys her with the Chronicom ships.
stages.whoA: The Inhuman who destroys her.
stages.whoB: The Chronicom leader, whom she destroys.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.text: Sibyl holds Simmons prisoner and has the Chronicoms dig into her mind to learn whether Fitz is alive.
stages.whoA: Her prisoner, whose mind she searches for Fitz.
stages.whoB: The Chronicom leader who holds her prisoner.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.text: Coulson destroys the Chronicoms' time ship and Sibyl's body with it, forcing her into a computer. She keeps hunting S.H.I.E.L.D. through time.
stages.whoA: The agent who destroys her body.
stages.whoB: The Chronicom leader he fights through time.
